vectors.notes: A 12.5% gain/loss is worth 48.0769...% at the 26% base.
ETF/fund LOSS is 'redditi diversi' → goes into the loss pool (zainetto).
Unlike positions, the tax base deducts sell FEES but NOT withheld taxes: proceeds = 480-2 = 478; cost = 100.5*4 = 402; gain 76.

2025: stock loss 200 → zaino 200 (expires 2029). 2026: ETF gain 500 is 'redditi di capitale' taxed in full at 26% (=130), zaino NOT used. BTP gain 300 at 12.5% → base equivalent 144.23, offset by zaino → tax 0, zaino left 55.77.
Dichiarativo: annual net (+200 -200 = 0) → no tax, no loss. Manual loss of year Y is added AFTER the year's netting (usable from Y+1). Per-event lossesUsed/estimatedTax stay null.
Same trades in amministrato: gain first (200, offset by manual 50 → tax 39), loss later creates zaino 200 that cannot go back in time.
2020 loss 500 usable until 31/12/2024 (2020+4): it expires at end 2024 (lossesExpired in 2024), so the 2025 gain is fully taxed (500*26%=130).
Crypto always annual (declaration). 2024 net 1500 ≤ 2000 exemption → 0. 2025 loss 400 → crypto-only pool (nominal, not base-26). 2026 gain 1000 - 400 = 600 at 33% = 198.
2025: 184 invested days/365 × 0.2% × year-end value. 2026 (current): estimate=true, projected days from first invested day to 31/12 → 365/365.

ETF gain 500 → 130 tax, zaino untouched.
ETF loss → lossesCreated 200, taxDelta 0.
quantity<=0 or price<=0 → null.
Shared (createdByUserId null) instrument: stored rate/harmonized ignored → 26%, harmonized presumed true.
Amministrato without crypto: yearly (estimatedTax - withheld) spread across the year's events pro-rata to each event's (estimatedTax - withheld), dated on the event.
Dichiarativo or crypto-year: whole remaining dated at 31/12 (or today for the open year).
ETF gains are not compensable; crypto excluded; losses expressed as positive base-26 equivalents.
Dates counted backwards from maturity in steps of 12/frequency months; window is (from, to].
Last 5 complete calendar years; (last/first)^(1/span)-1 = (1.45/1)^(1/4)-1.
gross = grossAmount*fx; withheld = taxes+fees; years newest first; 12 months each.
Ex-dates after first buy with quantity held the day before, no registered income in [-5,+60] days, not dismissed. estimatedTax = gross × fx(instrument→user) × taxRate.
Window = next 12 full calendar months. Source ex-dates of the same window one year earlier, shifted +12 months, times today's quantity, converted at TODAY's fx; net = gross × (1 - taxRate).
